heuristics.scope: all .rs files under crates/<crate>/; excludes */target/* and crates/clean-kernel/src/env/ (another lane owns its content)

unwrap_baseline_2026_09_21c: 2026-09-21: unwrap_expect_production 1231 -> 1233 (+2), both in one site and both the SANCTIONED kind. The simp-projection package (CLAUDE.md class 60) moved `ProofState::tc_cache` from a `RefCell` to a `Mutex` so the type-checker cache could be reached from a `&self` path that must be `Sync`, and the three `.lock()` calls in crates/clean-elab/src/tactic/core/type_check.rs carry `.expect("tc_cache poisoned")`. `rust_excellence.md` allows exactly this: "`.expect(\"reason\")` is acceptable only for programmer-invariant violations (e.g., mutex poisoning...)". A poisoned mutex here means a previous panic while the cache was held, which is not a recoverable condition and must not be papered over with a silent fallback — the cache would be in an unknown state. Two of the three are new; the third replaced an existing borrow.
